gen-dafont-visitor-gf-mada: Mada has curves that refuse to close and a midzone that towers over everything around it. Visitor's pixel-like heading, with its gaping e and one steady line, gives the page a nostalgic digital flicker above that friendly sans.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-martel-sans: Nostalgic and a bit digital, Visitor stamps its headings with gaping e shapes. Martel Sans follows in a plain sans with generous openings in every curve and a high mean line, so a long passage moves along easily without any fuss.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-matangi: Contemporary in its manner, Matangi presses twine-like strokes into a flat surface, leaving its rounded letters open and hefty. Visitor sits above it, nostalgic and digital.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro keeps a welcoming gap in its c and a high-waisted lowercase, all in a gentle monotone line. Maven Pro against Visitor's gaping e and short ascenders over big bowls is the pairing's strongest quality: retro pixel attitude meeting a modern sans.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-michroma: Wide-set and tall-bodied, with a retro-digital grin up top. Visitor is best at stout, solder-drawn display lettering where every diagonal matches every upright, while Michroma gives each letter a wide berth and stubby ascender tips for the sans-serif text below.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable from the first line, Miriam Libre draws its s with generous openings between the bends, with a wire-like weight. And over a longer stretch that sturdy lowercase, standing like cast iron capitals, keeps the sans text easy to follow beneath Visitor's nostalgic heading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Visitor brings nostalgic, digital lettering with gaping e shapes and strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle. Mochiy Pop One answers with a very large lowercase eye and letters hung like clothespins, and that mix of pixel-era grit and tidy sans-serif is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Chunky retro screen charm, courtesy of Visitor's gaping e and short ascenders over big bowls. But Mochiy Pop P One keeps a wide stretch of blank space between its sizable lowercase letters, so a longer passage in this sans-serif moves along gently.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-montserrat-underli: Montserrat Underline has counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Montserrat Underline over a longer passage stays smooth, with round bowls of unswelling walls, while Visitor's nostalgic heading sits apart as the plain sans below.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads with big-bodied lowercase letters and a splayed c terminal, approachable and contemporary. Visitor's neon-tube glow is the pair's strongest quality.
